narrative: The foot of the last sheet, the couplet just wet. Gib has not moved onto this sheet. He is still on the chronicle. No face. A line ruled under the couplet. Nothing written beneath the rule. No face. The margin, beside the rule, has the count of days and not a sum of money. No face.

entities.name: William Shakespeare
entities.context: Wrote the couplet and ruled the line.

entities.name: Gib
entities.context: Stayed on the chronicle, off the sheet.
